source: Mensagem autoral de 2026-11-20: acelerar entregas dramáticas no Capítulo 3, batalhas de escala, feridas, explosões, fogo, Legião/Varo/cidade reativos, Três Poderes e economia funcionando, reputação continental de AERÚN, Miren/Astra e Tessa Arin, autômato antigo superior, topologia Coração-Cérebro-Membros-Corpo, sala do Coração, sigilo sobre antigo portador de CREATION, colaboração de Lucas; reduzir episódios triviais.

proposed_repair_options: Reedit one-day-scoped parts maintaining all events but requiring additional author choices
Request explicit, technically reviewed exception for multiple fully narrated contiguous calendar days in a single part; test before archival

core_change.chapter3_mandate: Deliver concrete large-scale conflict and tangible plot advancement inside Chapter 3, not another 5-part prologue, without assuming the protagonist's actions.
core_change.scope: Dramatic acceleration = faster causal milestones, not silent time jumps or automatic geography.
core_change.make_city_bleed: A major civic threat must be attempted by an already established or plausibly introduced antagonist. If it reaches the populace, Três Arcos suffers a credible civic wound beyond instant material repair. No fabricated losses if fully prevented by player/defenders.
core_change.later_ithran: Earlier Ithran-led 'first wound' blueprint remains as high-stakes multi-sector imperial assault, but exclusive claim to FIRST civic defeat is superseded; Ithran may exploit or deepen an earlier wound, not receive credit for another operation by default.
core_change.not_predetermined: Specific casualties, named character injuries, military outcome, Lucas tactics, institutional decisions, and fate of attackers remain open. Enemy has agency, defenders competence.

needed: Start from canonically valid resolution of C02 PV and new author choice
Civic crisis warning or first actual major hostile action; named residents/guards participate
Varo, six Sombras and civic authorities independently act against real danger
At least one prior mystery advances from evidence to a testable lead
Lucas returns as central actor with full options
five_part_structure.payoff: Concrete action, not briefing-only; expose battlefield stakes and who is threatened

needed: Full-scale magical/physical fantasy battle in a geographically coherent urban sector or allied external theater
Fire, ruptures, magic, wounds and evacuations appear only as caused by actions that really occur; no operational sabotage instructions
Legion units each execute credible missions; Sombras are not forced blind
Civic bodies invoke their jurisdiction, not unlimited powers
Antagonist adapts and pays price
five_part_structure.payoff: Visible physical stakes and human consequence; victory/defeat real

five_part_structure.stage: O Coração, o Cérebro e a máquina impossível
needed: Miren and Astra earn a major Tessa Arin discovery via identified physical evidence plus independent validation
May discover schematic hint that Heart is one subsystem of distributed ancient system, with a governing 'Brain', remote 'Limbs' and a larger 'Body'—these are HYPOTHESES until tested
Ancient most-advanced automaton is proposed: first documentary clue/specimen, not arbitrary sentient ally
Decision whether and how to approach sealed Heart chamber must be genuinely evaluated by institute, not automatic opening
Proposed risk of former CREATION wielder is labeled conjecture or archival record with provenance and possible false interpretation
five_part_structure.payoff: One large, verifiable scientific revelation with new danger and choices; personal Miren/Astra moment

needed: Major tactical escalation, Varo leadership and veterans' initiative; defense restructured because battle, not because a PowerPoint
Lucas participates and may use unrestricted GÊNESE while collaborating with other leaders and researchers
Civilian response conveys anger, compassion, loyalty, criticism and agency, not uniform hatred
Casa dos Três Poderes exercises executive, legislative and judicial distinctions amid emergency
Lysa leads concrete economic recovery/contract/credit measures with real tracked resources; bank/Casa da Economia status does not spontaneously become operational
five_part_structure.payoff: Hard-won turning point; city stands even if it feels less safe

five_part_structure.stage: Nenhum fica para trás — a promessa provada
needed: Climax resolves a confrontation or investigative objective with a lasting outcome
Material restoration can be near-instant but trust, grief and memory are not under Lucas control
Legion/Varo and citizens own the defense; no forced praise or hero-only victory
AERÚN sends verified findings via plausible regional channels and gains recognition gradually, not immediate worldwide fame
Miren and Astra may choose confidential treatment of sensitive findings with ethical cost and possible conflict with Lucas
Tharvek/Elyrien/distant factions progress through real routes; do not teleport into city for Ithran
five_part_structure.payoff: Meaningful victory and an unavoidable emotional change from events actually narrated, not an arbitrary cliffhanger

Três Poderes.base: Casa física created D539, offices still evolving, Casa das Garantias only physical wing/temporary provisional protections from D544 and C02PV draft.
Três Poderes.executive: Kael or lawful delegates coordinate emergency services, routes, water/health and communication with citizens, with capacity limits.
Três Poderes.legislative: Open accountable deliberation on emergency powers, budget and civil liberties with named dissent, consent and feasible timings.
Três Poderes.judiciary: Independent procedure: evidence custody, lawful arrest, review, defense; Varo does not become judge by force; no lynch law.
Três Poderes.acceptance: Institutions must visibly change a concrete outcome for residents rather than merely hold ceremonial meeting.

economy.base: Lysa has economic leadership; House of Economy / municipal bank activation not confirmed canon as operating entity.
economy.proposal: If founded lawfully, Casa da Economia/treasury directs resources, vouchers, wages, prices, trade credit or emergency reconstruction with auditable source and impact; no automatic creation of monetary institution.
economy.acceptance: At least one tangible financial effect observed by named household or business, not made-up GDP or instant 1m citizens.

legion.base: Founding 300 free conscious beings; Varo commander/current transition is institutionally nuanced; six Sombras autonomous.
legion.proposal: Defensive doctrine, companies, special response, civilian rescue, intelligence and voluntary recruits may expand through decisions, not mass-created humans.
legion.acceptance: Show tactical decision, effective rescue/failure cost, discipline after grief, allies' initiative, never artificial incompetence or automatic national army.

aerun.base: Miren director, Astra vice; Heart sealed; Tessa old recording D112; regional Costura exists, further network unknown.
aerun.proposal: Independent scientific discovery, controlled trials, academic recognition disseminated by real relays and travelers, ethical containment protocol.
aerun.acceptance: Novel, falsifiable finding AND personal conflict rather than another unlabelled metal cylinder.

confirmed: Heart of Convergence sealed below old Três Arcos, receives/redistributes mana
Tessa Arin archival warning and ancient recording, no proof alive
Units A/B/C, observation/form/link and secondary validation node historically partial

author_theories.idea: Heart may be energy-circulation node in geographically extended Architect construct; 'Brain' a decision/coordination node, 'Limbs' remote actuators and 'Body' distributed material/technological substrate.
A specially engineered Architect automaton beyond Units A/B/C may exist; consciousness, location, allegiance, autonomy and abilities unknown.
Tessa's restricted records may concern a prior user or earlier embodiment of CREATION, with dangerous consequences; the identity, occurrence and relationship to Lucas not known or canon.
Miren/Astra evaluate access to sealed chamber with risks, precautions, scientific approval and choice; actual opening requires narrated decision and events.

scientific_mystery_graph.secrecy_ethics: Miren and Astra may temporarily withhold potentially harmful unresolved data from others including Lucas, only with credible motives, proportional reasons and emotional/ethical consequence. No forced deception, character assassination, fake license to conceal existential threat.
scientific_mystery_graph.non_equivalence: Do NOT conflate Architect Network with Velkar/Aethron/Talis/origin of GÊNESE absent evidence. Heart is not infinite energy. Ancient tech cannot arbitrarily neutralize GÊNESE.

characters_and_enemy.Lucas: Creative protagonist, present in major scenes and actions; high-tech genius and irreverent humor, GÊNESE full; author chooses battles, creations, strategy; no conscious-life creation this stage.
characters_and_enemy.Miren: Arcanist-scientist with independent professional agency and intimate emotional bond with Lucas, not secret-keeping robot or perfunctory love interest.
characters_and_enemy.Astra: Co-investigator and skeptical peer, retains scientific initiative and can disagree with Miren.
characters_and_enemy.Varo: Strategic independent defender, allowed rage and grief; responds with competence not arbitrary weakness.
characters_and_enemy.Legiao: Veteran identities and living doctrine, casualties/wounds reflect demonstrated events; feelings not universal.
characters_and_enemy.Citizens: People angry, caring, frightened, resilient, critical and proud with individual stories; never a single personality.
characters_and_enemy.Vesra: Known enemy behind previous assaults and departed city in C02PV manuscript, not necessarily subordinate of Ithran/Velkar; attack attribution requires evidence.
characters_and_enemy.Ithran: Threat of future coordinated invasion, preserve original superior Serakh, arrival logistics and multi-sector scope; not automatic author of C03 attack.
characters_and_enemy.Tharvek_Elyrien: Current separate provinces; delegates left by roads D546/D547 in noncanon draft; do not teleport or reveal imperial origin without source.

operational_guards: Do not turn schedule into railroading or write the battle before author chooses Lucas action.
Strong antagonist can lose, be captured, retreat or die, without retcon.
Furious citizens/Legion may demand justice, but violence by suspects requires lawful investigation; no militarized dictatorship as automatic outcome.
Drama can be devastating without fixed death-count quota or automatic suffering of innocents.
GÊNESE can rebuild material instantly, not change minds or erase memories.
No more low-stakes cart-wheels/bakery/small infrastructure as repeated headline; quotidian scenes appear only as anchors or contrasts after major action.
No dozens of fragmented quickcuts replacing substantial cinematic fight, discovery and aftermath scenes.
Maintain day, time, POV, travel, sources, character knowledge and canonical witnesses.
Technical chronology issue of Chapter 2 Part V is independent from creative direction and must be solved before any canon promotion.
